name: Kim TallBear
shortBio: Sisseton Wahpeton Oyate philosopher of science and Indigenous STS scholar who dismantled genetic determinism in Native American DNA and articulated Indigenous relationality.
centralQuestion: Why does reducing Indigenous kinship and nationhood to molecular DNA sequences perpetuate settler-colonial race science?

keyWorks.title: Native American DNA: Tribal Belonging and the False Promise of Genetic Science
keyWorks.description: Epistemological and political critique of commercial genomics vs. Indigenous relational governance and tribal citizenship.
